topic: GJR coefficients and their own standard errors
remaining: None; boundary estimates retain the stated inference qualification.
response: Both positive-shock loadings $\alpha_i$ and negative-shock loadings $\gamma_i$ now have their own standard errors, at both frequencies. The difference $\gamma_i-\alpha_i$ is also retained. Its covariance with $\alpha_i$ is included when calculating $SE(\hat\gamma_i)$: $\operatorname{Var}(\hat\gamma_i)=\operatorname{Var}(\hat\alpha_i)+\operatorname{Var}(\widehat{\gamma_i-\alpha_i})+2\operatorname{Cov}(\hat\alpha_i,\widehat{\gamma_i-\alpha_i})$. Normal inference remains qualified at active bounds.

topic: AR(2) equivalence and the scope of stationarity
status: Derivation and scope clarified in this revision
remaining: No joint inflation–SPF VAR or full switched-system stationarity analysis has been estimated.
response: No sign restriction is needed. Let $r_1,r_2$ solve $p(r)=r^2-\rho_1r-\rho_2=0$; these are companion-matrix eigenvalues, reciprocal to roots of the lag polynomial. If $|r_j|<1$, then $p(1)>0$, $p(-1)>0$, and $r_1r_2=-\rho_2<1$, giving the three stated inequalities. Conversely, for conjugate roots, $|r_j|^2=-\rho_2<1$. For real roots, $p(1)>0$ places both on the same side of 1, and $p(-1)>0$ places both on the same side of $-1$; $r_1r_2<1$ rules out both being above 1 or below $-1$. Hence both are inside the unit circle. The report collects mean and volatility restrictions beside the GARCH equations and in the regime-switching and BEGE bounds tables. These checks restrict the inflation AR block conditional on observed SPF; they do not establish joint inflation–SPF stationarity. No SPF law of motion is estimated. Regime-by-regime stability alone also does not prove stability of an arbitrary switching AR system.

topic: EWMA initialization and explosive variance paths
status: Investigated; envelope removed by prior decision
remaining: The suggested tighter envelope and full joint-process stationarity proof are not supplied.
response: I no longer impose the EWMA bound on the implied variance. Estimations with and without the bound gave essentially the same results, and the bound was never active at a converged estimate. With the current BEGE density evaluator, the likelihood does not overflow without it.

topic: BEGE jobs, starts, and computational screening
status: Start hierarchy clarified; screening not implemented
remaining: No likelihood-screening benchmark or screened-versus-random search comparison.
response: A seed job is an independently seeded batch. The current protocol is 10 jobs, each with 40 batches of 25 optimizer starts: 10,000 starts per mean/specification/frequency, reduced from the earlier 50-job protocol. Each of the 25 starts draws both mean and volatility parameters anew, then optimizes them jointly; the mean is not held at one draw for all 25 starts. Only the best eligible result of each batch is saved. Parallel jobs distribute the cost, but all starts are optimized. The proposed likelihood screen, retained pure-random fraction, and timing comparison with that alternative remain unimplemented.

topic: Full BEGE fit and proposed shape restrictions
status: Both proposed restrictions estimated at both frequencies
remaining: Reconciliation of unrestricted Full BEGE archived searches remains outstanding.
response: Both proposed restrictions have now been estimated at both frequencies, with 10,000 random starts per mean/specification/frequency. Both retain the full n recursion and use nine free volatility parameters. Comparing the four reported means: quarterly Symmetric-p/full-n: lower AIC than the current Full BEGE fit in 3 of four means, lower BIC in 4; quarterly Positive-only-p/full-n: lower AIC than the current Full BEGE fit in 2 of four means, lower BIC in 4; monthly Symmetric-p/full-n: lower AIC than the current Full BEGE fit in 0 of four means, lower BIC in 3; monthly Positive-only-p/full-n: lower AIC than the current Full BEGE fit in 3 of four means, lower BIC in 3. Standard errors are computed only for the selected best estimates. The restricted-model comparison reports likelihood and criterion differences using the same mean and sample. Separately, the admissible archived quarterly Full BEGE ARX(2,2) candidate has log likelihood −168.8770 versus −168.9699 in the current Full report; the unrestricted archived searches have not been merged. A restricted likelihood above a saved Full likelihood indicates incomplete numerical search, not a rejection of nesting.

remaining: Literal division by three and a preceding-quarter SPF regressor for every month have not been estimated as alternatives.
response: Monthly OLS, GARCH-family, regime-switching, and BEGE results are included. The forecast is repeated within each target quarter, but uses exact geometric de-compounding, $100[(1+q/100)^{1/3}-1]$, rather than $q/3$, matching the supplied workbook. The second SPF regressor is lagged one month: April uses the March and December survey forecasts; May and June use the March forecast in both SPF columns. If the intended second regressor is instead the previous quarterly survey throughout April–June, that alternative has not been estimated. The current convention is preserved, and the proposed monthly comparison is now available for review.
